servicesPage.title: All Our Services
servicesPage.subtitle: A professional approach to every document type with guaranteed quality.

apostille.desc: An apostille is an official form of certification that ensures the international recognition of a document and is issued by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Ministry of Justice, or the Ministry of Education. We provide apostille services for all types of official documents.

legalization.desc: Legalization is the process of officially recognizing foreign documents in Uzbekistan and vice versa. We handle the entire process for you.

translation.desc: Professional written document translation. We translate legal, medical, technical and other documents across all fields.

notarial.desc: Notarial certification of translations. Many official institutions require a notarially certified translation.

personal.desc: Translation of personal documents — certificates, diplomas, transcripts, passports, references and more.

medical.desc: Professional translation of medical documents — medical records, reports, prescriptions and other medical documentation.

consultation.desc: Not sure which service you need? Get a free consultation. Our specialists will point you in the right direction.

about.title: Tashkent's #1 Translation Service

story.title: How We Started
story.p1: Переводы №1 was founded in Tashkent over 16 years ago. Since then, we have helped thousands of clients translate and certify their documents.
story.p2: Today we are one of the most trusted translation services in Central Asia. An individual approach to every document, confidentiality and quality guarantee — these are our core principles.
